neighbours.label: disease-outbreak case counts: the words leading into 'cases' / 'infections' in an epidemic report ('rise in [cases]', 'number of confirmed [cases]', '14,000 new [infections]')
fire: Health officials in Peru reported the largest number of confirmed cases of cholera in a decade.

notes: Card: ' confirmed' x4, ' of', ' in', ' Covid', '0', all just before 'cases' or 'infected' in swine-flu and Covid reports. Probes: 'sharpest rise in cases' 0.42, 'confirmed cases of dengue' 0.62, 'new infections' 0.46, 'highly contagious' 0.30; 'confirmed our reservation ... rise in prices' 0.03; a detective's cases 0.00. The + pole is an unrelated baseball-postseason context.
